description: New token launches with a safety verdict on each — the newest DEX pools on a chain (base default; ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, avalanche, solana), every token scored 0-100 and labeled safe / caution / risky / avoid from honeypot, buy/sell tax, mint, owner-can-change-balance, proxy, LP lock and top-10 holder flags, plus liquidity, 24h volume, buys/sells and age. A token whose check did not finish comes back checked:false, never guessed. 404/free if no pool in the window. Costs $0.05 per call, paid from clink's shop credits (an existing key; new top-ups are paused). A failed or empty call is free.

chain.description: base (default), ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, avalanche, solana
